d:
Seventeen undertrial prisoners escaped from a sub-jail in Tamil Nadu’s Theni district on the night of October 26, 2026. According to police, the prisoners allegedly faked a medical emergency and attacked jail staff when the cell door was opened. Four prisoners have been arrested, while a search operation is underway for the remaining 13. In this explainer, we look at how the escape reportedly happened, the police operation to track the fugitives, and the questions raised about jail security.
